subject: english
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: Take it up, and write your own storry.
Take it up, and writte your on story.
Take it up, and write your own story.
Take it up, and write your own stori.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Take it up, and write your own story.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence, "Take it up, and write your own story," is free from spelling errors.
 
• "**Take**": This word is correctly spelt and refers to the action of grabbing or accepting something.
